description: This file defines a generic interface 'ICatalogLookupDataService' for data services that retrieve lookup data, with a method 'List' returning a task of list of lookup data objects.

classes.name: ICatalogLookupDataService
classes.description: A generic interface for catalog lookup data services that support asynchronous listing of lookup data items.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of lookup data items.
